# NodeSlide

NodeSlide is a hosted deck-as-code editor that turns prompts, structured specifications,
web evidence, and uploaded files into editable, reviewable, presentable slide decks.

## Canonical links

- [NodeSlide prototype](https://parity-studio.vercel.app/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/HomenShum/parity-studio)

## Product behavior

- AI changes are proposed and validated before they can mutate a deck.
- Slides remain structured and exportable rather than becoming static slide images.
- Provider, model, effort, timing, token, cost, tool, and source evidence is exposed in Trace.
- External model and web access require explicit user consent.

## Agent access

Use the in-product BYOK / Agents surface for MCP connection instructions and scoped tools.
Treat published deck links as user-authored artifacts; verify their individual citations.
